subject: [hw] DONE V12
body:
V12 (A32 load/store + load/store multiple + exclusives; branches, system, hints) done, host-tested only, no phone.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v12/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST V12 PASS 200743/200743
(printed twice: once for clang -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all, once for -O2 without sanitizers; ~4.8 s total.)
200743 checks = 461 unit assertions + 2x141 llvm-mc encodings (each fed to both entry points) + 200000 random sweep words. All encodings generated by llvm-mc from assembly text in test_v12/gen_enc.py; no hand-typed hex. Expected values are literals from the ARM ARM pseudocode.

Files (all new, only my owned paths): gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_mem.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/n2a32_arm_misc.c, gpu/hwcodec/emu/test_v12/{run_tests.sh,t_v12.c,gen_enc.py,STATUS.md}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/V12/STATUS.md.

Implemented: LDR/STR/LDRB/STRB (imm, literal, shifted register incl. LSR#32/ASR#32/RRX, pre/post index, writeback, unaligned, LDRT/STRT/LDRBT/STRBT, LDR pc via n2a32_bx); LDRH/STRH/LDRSB/LDRSH/LDRD/STRD; LDM/STM IA/IB/DA/DB with writeback, POP/PUSH, PC through n2a32_bx; LDREX/STREX/B/H/D through n2a32_excl_mark/store; CLREX; PLD/PLI/PLDW no-ops; B/BL/BLX(imm)/BX/BLX(reg); SVC/BKPT/UDF stop codes; NOP/YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/HINT/DBG no-ops; DMB/DSB/ISB no-ops; MRC p15,0,Rt,c13,c0,3 = tpidruro.

Not done / open:
1. V02 a32_route still misroutes 7 groups of my space (posted exact masks/matches to hw-v02 at 11:43): P=0 LDR/STR register -> arm_media; extra loads/stores with P=0 or U=0 -> arm_dp; YIELD/WFE/WFI/SEV/DBG -> arm_dp; U=0 PLD/PLI and all PLDW -> arm_misc/neon_ldst. Not verified through n2a32_run until that is fixed.
2. V02 n2a32_excl.c not in the tree; tests use a local value-based CAS stand-in. CLREX clears c->excl_valid directly (no n2a32_excl_clear in the frozen header).
3. D01 census/FACTS.md not in the tree. FYI [V]: every defined FUNC symbol in libvcodecdrv/libvcodec_utility/libvpud_vcodec has an odd st_value -> those libraries are Thumb-2 only (1546/677/80 symbols, zero ARM), contrary to PLAN 1.2 "8 of 1692 exports are Thumb". Posted to hw-d01. If any ARM code uses MRC p15 c13 c0 2 (TPIDRURW) or another cp15 read, it is UNDEF today; send me the word and I implement it.
4. T01 differential harness not run yet (core landed without excl/stub classes); V12 is ready to add its kernels when T01 asks.
5. Deliberately UNDEF: Rt=15 byte/half/signed/doubleword transfers, odd LDRD/STRD Rt, LDM/STM with S bit, exclusives touching r15, LDM/STM or preloads with cond=F that are not PLD/PLI/PLDW, BXJ, every MRC/MCR except the TPIDRURO read, CPS/SETEND/HVC/SMC/ERET. Full table in STATUS.md.

No phone access, nothing published.
